meta.dataset: China-side foreign-exchange rules for an individual converting CNY to USD
meta.verification_convention: verification=verified means the value was read directly from the cited official publisher page on the cited date. verification=partial means part of the row is confirmed and part is not. verification=unverified means the value could not be confirmed from an official publisher and is left blank.

rows.topic: Annual facilitation quota (年度便利化额度)
rows.value: USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year, separately for 结汇 (FX->CNY) and for 境内个人购汇 (CNY->FX)
rows.detail: SAFE's Current Account FX Business Guidelines (2020 edition) Art. 54: 个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元. Note the asymmetry: the quota is stated for '个人结汇' (all individuals settling FX) and for '境内个人购汇' (domestic individuals buying FX) only.
rows.implication: Buying USD with CNY inside China (购汇) by a 境内个人 is ID-only within USD 50k/yr. This is the single most important constraint on a simple CNY->USD conversion.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette (国务院公报), reprinting 汇发〔2020〕14号 issued by SAFE
rows.source_title: 国家外汇管理局关于印发《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》的通知 — 第五十四条

rows.topic: Quota is not a ceiling on lawful conversion
rows.detail: SAFE's own policy Q&A states: 目前对于真实、合法的经常项目和已开放的资本项目下购汇和结汇都没有金额限制. 年度便利化额度不是个人每年购汇或者结汇的限额 — the USD 50k figure is a documentary-convenience threshold, not a legal maximum. Above it, the same transaction remains lawful if documentary evidence of the transaction is supplied.
rows.implication: This is the key corrector to the widespread belief that 'only USD 50,000 can ever leave China per year'. Above the quota the constraint becomes evidence, not amount.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), Ningxia branch
rows.source_title: 2022年外汇业务政策释疑（八）

rows.topic: Over-quota current-account purchase (documentary route)
rows.value: No statutory amount limit; requires 本人有效身份证件 + 有交易额的购汇资金用途材料
rows.detail: Guidelines 2020 Art. 56: 境内个人凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金用途材料，在银行办理不占用年度便利化额度的经常项目购汇.
rows.implication: The lawful large-transfer route for an individual who is a Chinese national or a foreigner resident in China. It works only if the underlying purpose is a genuine current-account item (study, travel, medical, family support, wages, services).
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette, reprinting 汇发〔2020〕14号
rows.source_title: 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》 — 第五十六条

rows.topic: Remitting existing foreign-currency savings out of China
rows.value: Up to USD 50,000 equivalent per day by ID alone; above that, documentary evidence
rows.detail: Guidelines 2020 Art. 64(1): 外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理。Note this is a DAILY figure, not annual.
rows.implication: Once CNY has been lawfully converted to USD and sits in an FX savings account, outward remittance is comparatively unconstrained. The binding constraint is therefore the 购汇 step, not the wire.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette, reprinting 汇发〔2020〕14号
rows.source_title: 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》 — 第六十四条

rows.topic: Purpose restrictions written into the FX purchase application
rows.value: Six prohibitions, including: 不得用于境外买房、证券投资、购买人寿保险和投资性返还分红类保险等尚未开放的资本项目
rows.detail: The 个人购汇申请书 (Individual FX Purchase Application) is reproduced as an annex to a SAFE branch publication. It lists six prohibitions and states that violators are placed on the 关注名单 with no facilitation quota for the year of listing plus the two following years.
rows.implication: Overseas property, overseas securities, and life/return-of-premium insurance are closed capital-account purposes. Framing a transfer as one of these is a false declaration. Formulating a lawful plan therefore means identifying a genuine current-account or open-capital-account purpose.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
rows.source_title: 附件1 个人购汇申请书

rows.topic: Splitting / structuring prohibition and the 'watch list'
rows.value: Watch-list period = year of listing + 2 following years, during which the facilitation quota is unavailable
rows.detail: Guidelines 2020 Art. 62: 个人不得以分拆等方式规避便利化额度管理及真实性管理。外汇局对规避管理的个人实行'关注名单'管理。 (一) lending your own quota to help another triggers a written risk warning; a repeat triggers watch-listing. (二) borrowing another's quota places you on the watch list directly. (三) 关注期限为列入'关注名单'的当年及之后连续2年.
rows.implication: Using relatives' or friends' USD 50k quotas to move a larger sum ('smurfing' / 蚂蚁搬家) is expressly addressed and is a defined violation, not a grey area.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette, reprinting 汇发〔2020〕14号
rows.source_title: 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》 — 第六十二条

rows.topic: Penalty for evasion of foreign exchange (逃汇)
rows.value: Fine of up to 30% of the evaded amount; if serious, 30% up to 100% of the amount; repatriation ordered
rows.detail: Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (State Council Order No. 532, 2008) Art. 39: 有违反规定将境内外汇转移境外，或者以欺骗手段将境内资本转移境外等逃汇行为的，由外汇管理机关责令限期调回外汇，处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。
rows.implication: The downside of an unlawful route is quantified in the statute: a fine measured as a percentage of the sum moved, plus forced repatriation, plus criminal exposure. This is the number to compare against the ~0.3-0.6% cost of the lawful route.
rows.source_publisher: Beijing Municipal People's Government portal, republishing 国务院令第532号
rows.source_title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 — 第三十九条

rows.topic: Penalty for illegal arbitrage of FX (非法套汇) and false documents
rows.value: Illegal arbitrage: up to 30% of the amount, or 30%-100% if serious. False/incomplete documents: up to CNY 50,000 for an individual.
rows.detail: Art. 40: 有违反规定以外汇收付应当以人民币收付的款项，或者以虚假、无效的交易单证等向经营结汇、售汇业务的金融机构骗购外汇等非法套汇行为的…处非法套汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处非法套汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。Art. 48: 未按照规定提交有效单证或者提交的单证不真实的…对个人可以处5万元以下的罚款。
rows.implication: Documentary abuse is separately penalised from evasion, and can be charged alongside it.
rows.source_publisher: Beijing Municipal People's Government portal, republishing 国务院令第532号
rows.source_title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 — 第四十条, 第四十八条

rows.topic: Penalty for unauthorised FX trading / underground banks
rows.value: Warning, confiscation of gains, fine up to 30% of the amount (30%-100% if serious); criminal liability possible
rows.detail: Art. 45: 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，没收违法所得，处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。Art. 46 penalises unlicensed FX settlement businesses.
rows.implication: Applies directly to 地下钱庄 (underground bank) conversion, which is the channel most often recommended informally for large sums.
rows.source_publisher: Beijing Municipal People's Government portal, republishing 国务院令第532号
rows.source_title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 — 第四十五条, 第四十六条

rows.topic: Penalty for carrying FX in or out in breach of the rules
rows.value: Warning; fine of up to 20% of the amount; customs penalties where applicable
rows.detail: Art. 42: 违反规定携带外汇出入境的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。法律、行政法规规定由海关予以处罚的，从其规定。
rows.source_publisher: Beijing Municipal People's Government portal, republishing 国务院令第532号
rows.source_title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 — 第四十二条
rows.implication: FX cash beyond the declaration threshold must be declared; carrying it out undeclared exposes you to forfeiture and a fine of up to 20% of the amount, separately from any customs penalty. It is not a substitute for a bank transfer.

rows.topic: Carrying foreign cash out of China
rows.value: Up to USD 5,000: no permit. USD 5,000-10,000: bank-issued 携带证. Above USD 10,000: SAFE-issued 携带证; in principle not permitted
rows.detail: SAFE/Customs Order 汇发〔2003〕102号, Art. 5 and 7. Art. 5(1) 不超过等值5000美元的，不需申领《携带证》; (2) 5000-10000美元 应当向银行申领《携带证》; (3) 超过10000美元 应当向…外汇局申领《携带证》. Art. 7: 原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元外币现钞出境. Bank-issued permits are capped at USD 10,000 each (Art. 9).
rows.implication: Cash is the lowest-capacity route by a wide margin. Moving a meaningful sum in cash would require dozens of trips and would itself be structuring.
rows.source_publisher: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) republication of the SAFE / General Administration of Customs joint order
rows.source_title: 国家外汇管理局、海关总署关于印发《携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法》的通知（汇发〔2003〕102号）

rows.topic: Carrying RMB cash out of China
rows.value: CNY 20,000 per person per trip
rows.detail: PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 18: 中国公民出入境、外国人入出境每人每次携带的人民币限额由原来的6000元调整为20000元，自2005年1月1日施行.
rows.source_publisher: People's Bank of China
rows.source_title: 中国人民银行公告〔2004〕第18号 — 调整国家货币出入境限额
rows.implication: RMB 20,000 is the ceiling for physical cash in a hand-carried bag per trip. It is small relative to any meaningful balance, so cash is a supplement to a bank transfer, never the route.

rows.topic: Overseas ATM cash withdrawal on a mainland-issued bank card
rows.value: CNY 100,000 equivalent per person per calendar year; CNY 10,000 equivalent per card per day
rows.detail: SAFE 汇发〔2017〕29号, Art. 1: 个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。超过年度额度的，本年及次年将被暂停持境内银行卡在境外提取现金。Art. 4: 外币卡由每卡每日不得超过等值1000美元调整为等值1万元人民币；人民币卡管理维持每卡每日不得超过等值1万元人民币。
rows.implication: Roughly USD 14,000/yr at the BOC rate — a useful but small channel, and capped per person, which rules out scaling by opening more accounts.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
rows.source_title: 国家外汇管理局关于规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易的通知（汇发〔2017〕29号）

rows.topic: Overseas card spending (consumption, not conversion)
rows.value: Not capped by the USD 50k facilitation quota; overseas consumption is explicitly outside it
rows.detail: SAFE's own Q&A on 汇发〔2017〕29号: 个人出境旅游、商务、留学所涉食、宿、行、购等经常项下交易，均可以使用银行卡支付，且不占用个人便利化年度5万美元购汇额度。
rows.implication: Spending while abroad is a lawful way to consume the money, but it is not a way to obtain USD you keep. Worth separating clearly, because the two are routinely conflated.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
rows.source_title: 国家外汇管理局有关负责人就规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易有关问题答记者问

rows.topic: Emigrant property transfer (移民转移) — structure
rows.value: Must be applied for once for the entire amount; paid out in stages: up to 50% first, up to half of the remainder after 1 year, the rest after 2 years. Amounts up to CNY 200,000 equivalent may be remitted in one go with approval.
rows.detail: PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16, Art. 6. Approval tier: Art. 10 — total up to CNY 500,000 equivalent is approved by the local SAFE branch; above that, local branch screens and SAFE headquarters approves. Art. 11 — after conversion the bank must remit directly to the applicant's own account in the destination country and may not hand out cash.
rows.implication: This is the only route that scales to large sums without a purpose-matching current-account transaction, but it is available only to a person who has emigrated from mainland China and it takes two years to complete.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette (国务院公报) — official text of 中国人民银行公告〔2004〕第16号
rows.source_title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 — 第六条, 第十条, 第十一条

rows.topic: Emigrant transfer — documentary conditions
rows.value: Requires cancelled PRC household registration (户籍注销证明), proof of settlement abroad certified by a PRC embassy/consulate, proof of the property right, and a tax payment certificate (税收证明或完税凭证) from the competent tax authority
rows.detail: Announcement [2004] No. 16, Art. 8. Art. 12 excludes property subject to judicial restriction or under civil/criminal proceedings, and property whose lawful source cannot be shown.
rows.implication: The tax certificate is the practical gate. In practice this route requires that the source assets have already been taxed or are documented as exempt.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette
rows.source_title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 — 第八条, 第十二条

rows.topic: Inheritance transfer (继承转移) — who may use it
rows.value: Foreign citizens and Hong Kong / Macao residents only, moving inherited mainland estate abroad
rows.detail: Announcement [2004] No. 16, Art. 2: 继承转移是指外国公民或香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区居民…将依法继承的境内遗产变现，通过外汇指定银行购汇和汇出境外的行为。Art. 9 requires the will/inheritance documents and the deceased's tax certificate. Taiwan residents are covered by Art. 14 by analogy.
rows.implication: A US citizen beneficiary of a mainland estate has a defined lawful route. Note it is NOT available to a mainland-resident heir who is not a foreign citizen.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette
rows.source_title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 — 第二条, 第九条, 第十四条

rows.topic: Sale of mainland property by a foreign individual
rows.value: Proceeds in CNY may be converted and remitted out with SAFE approval
rows.detail: 个人外汇管理办法 (PBOC Order [2006] No. 3), Art. 22: 境外个人出售境内商品房所得人民币，经外汇局核准可以购汇汇出。
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
rows.source_title: 个人外汇管理办法（中国人民银行令〔2006〕第3号）— 第二十二条
rows.implication: A foreign national who sells mainland residential property may convert and remit the proceeds, but only with SAFE approval (核准). This is the only route that converts property proceeds for someone who is not a PRC national.

rows.topic: Cross-border e-commerce and market-procurement settlement outside the quota
rows.value: Does not occupy the annual facilitation quota, if turnover evidence or electronic transaction information is supplied
rows.detail: Guidelines 2020 Art. 66(2)(3): 境内个人办理跨境电子商务项下结售汇，提供有交易额的材料或交易电子信息的，不占用个人年度便利化额度；个人办理市场采购贸易项下结汇，提供有交易额的材料或交易电子信息的，不占用个人年度便利化额度。
rows.implication: Relevant only if there is a genuine e-commerce or market-procurement business. It is not a general-purpose escape hatch, and the guidelines say the trade must be real.
rows.source_publisher: State Council Gazette, reprinting 汇发〔2020〕14号
rows.source_title: 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》 — 第六十六条

rows.topic: Domestic individuals investing abroad through qualified institutions (QDII)
rows.value: Permitted through qualifying domestic banks, fund companies and other institutions
rows.detail: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (汇发〔2007〕1号) Art. 17: 境内个人可以使用外汇或人民币，并通过银行、基金管理公司等合格境内机构投资者进行境外固定收益类、权益类等金融投资。For fund subscriptions the SAFE notice requires the individual to use their own domestic FX deposits and forbids paying in foreign cash.
rows.implication: QDII moves exposure abroad, but the asset is held inside the domestic wrapper; cashing out returns the money to a domestic FX account. It is not a way to hold USD outside China.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), Tianjin branch — official consolidated text of the Implementing Rules
rows.source_title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则（汇发〔2007〕1号）— 第十七条

rows.topic: Individuals lending to, or investing directly in, entities abroad
rows.value: Requires SAFE approval or registration; not a free channel
rows.detail: 个人外汇管理办法 Art. 21: 境内个人向境外提供贷款、借用外债、提供对外担保和直接参与境外商品期货和金融衍生产品交易，应当符合有关规定并到外汇局办理相应登记手续。Art. 16: 境内个人对外直接投资符合有关规定的，经外汇局核准可以购汇或以自有外汇汇出。
rows.implication: A 'loan to my own offshore company' is a registered capital-account transaction, not a workaround.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
rows.source_title: 个人外汇管理办法 — 第十六条, 第二十一条

rows.topic: Virtual currency conversion (USDT etc.)
rows.value: Prohibited. FX-for-virtual-currency conversion is classified as illegal financial activity.
rows.detail: 银发〔2021〕237号 (PBOC and nine other agencies), Art. 1(2): 开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务、虚拟货币之间的兑换业务…等虚拟货币相关业务活动…一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。Art. 1(3): 境外虚拟货币交易所通过互联网向我国境内居民提供服务同样属于非法金融活动。Art. 4(9): financial institutions and non-bank payment institutions may not provide account opening, fund transfer or clearing services for virtual-currency business.
rows.implication: Eliminates the most frequently suggested 'crypto bridge'. It is not a tax-efficiency question; the activity itself is prohibited and the banking rails are closed to it.
rows.source_publisher: People's Bank of China
rows.source_title: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知（银发〔2021〕237号）

rows.topic: Tax filing for outbound service-trade payments of USD 50,000 or more
rows.value: Tax filing (税务备案) required for a single outbound payment above USD 50,000 equivalent, with listed exceptions
rows.detail: STA/SAFE Announcement 2013 No. 40, Art. 1 and Art. 3. Guidelines 2020 Art. 49(4) restates that for a single service-trade outbound payment above USD 50,000 the domestic entity or individual must first complete the tax filing and the bank must verify the filed form.
rows.implication: This is the mechanism that makes the documentary route real: above USD 50,000 the bank will check that the tax position on the payment has been declared. It is a filing step, not a separate tax.
rows.source_publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
rows.source_title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局关于服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案有关问题的公告（2013年第40号）

rows.topic: Currency of tax calculation
rows.value: Tax is computed in RMB; foreign-currency income is converted at the RMB central parity rate (人民币汇率中间价)
rows.detail: Individual Income Tax Law Art. 16: 各项所得的计算，以人民币为单位。所得为人民币以外的货币的，按照人民币汇率中间价折合成人民币缴纳税款。
rows.source_publisher: National People's Congress (中国人大网)
rows.source_title: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会关于修改《中华人民共和国个人所得税法》的决定 — 第十二项
rows.implication: Tax is computed in RMB at the central parity rate, which is a different rate from the bank's dealing spread. Do not assume the rate used for your transfer is the rate used for your tax.

rows.topic: Definition of 境内个人 vs 境外个人 — unresolved tension between two official texts
rows.detail: Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations Art. 52(2) defines 境内个人 as 中国公民 and 外国人 in China who have resided continuously for one full year. The Implementing Rules Art. 37(1) instead define 境内个人 as Chinese citizens holding a resident ID card, military ID or armed-police ID. For a US citizen living in China these two definitions can point in different directions, and the size of the applicable facility varies with it: Guidelines Art. 59 grants the USD 50k purchase quota to a 境外个人 only if they hold a 外国人永久居留身份证 (foreigner permanent-residence ID).
rows.implication: FLAGGED. Whether a given US citizen in China may use the USD 50,000 purchase quota by ID alone, or must document every purchase, depends on which definition the bank applies. This project did not find an official text reconciling them, so no conclusion is asserted.
rows.source_publisher: Beijing Municipal People's Government portal (Regulations Art. 52); State Council Gazette (Guidelines Art. 59)
rows.source_title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 第五十二条; 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》第五十九条
